consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, asking yes/no: does the player's crafting_inventory hold item_count of type->item_id, so the fetch mission counts as complete?
scope: items reachable via the player's crafting_inventory() (carried PLUS nearby reachable surroundings), not merely the character's own carried/on-person items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — builds tmp_inv = u.crafting_inventory() and returns whether it has_amount(item_id, item_count) (with a charges fallback), computing the mission-complete verdict
divergence: The required part lies on the ground (or in a vehicle) one tile away, within crafting reach but not worn/wielded/in inventory: crafting_inventory() includes it so is_complete returns true, while an on-person possession check (visit_items / actor->has_amount in Excerpts 1-2) returns false — proving a person-scoped possession authority is the wrong reach
